messages.title: THE LAST SIGNAL
messages.subtitle: Three decisions. Two endings. One shared story runtime.
messages.intro: This is Mira. Our ship is drifting near the abandoned station. We have one battery left. Can you hear us?
messages.decision: The signal is fading. What will you do?
messages.rescue: Dock at the station and rescue the crew
messages.signal: Use the last battery to send a relay signal
messages.battle: Crossing the station requires an encounter. The story is waiting for the game state machine.
messages.relay: The relay is online. A rescue ship has answered. Your decision earned {trust} trust.
messages.alone:
ENDING / SILENCE
The station disappears behind you. The last signal is lost.
messages.orbit.alt: A stranded ship and a silent station
messages.battle.title: EXTERNAL GAME STATE / ENCOUNTER
messages.battle.help: Demo state machine: return a result to the waiting story action.
